description.value: Uno Gelato is a Vancouver artisan gelato maker producing small-batch, farm-to-cone gelato and sorbetto from scratch using local ingredients such as Vancouver Island sea salt, Avalon Dairy milk, and freshly harvested fruits and herbs. This location sits within the Vancouver Convention Centre at Canada Place, one of multiple city locations. The shop rotates seasonal flavours alongside year-round favourites, with a strong vegan sorbetto lineup and gluten-friendly options throughout.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Uno Gelato is an active artisan gelato business with explicitly stated vegan and gluten-friendly options, and the Canada Place OSM address aligns with the website's mention of a Vancouver Convention Centre location alongside a Kitsilano location, indicating a multi-location brand. Takeout is clearly confirmed by the format of service (cups, cones, pints) and listed delivery app partnerships. No bike parking, water refill, washroom, Wi-Fi, or charging evidence appears in either the OSM tags or website content.
